gsdBands.name: under 1 cm a pixel
gsdBands.description: Low flights (about 35 m or lower on 1-inch and 4/3 sensors) and original frames. Corn plants countable at V2 to V3; individual small weeds resolvable. Species work in the literature lives below 0.5 cm.

gsdBands.name: 1 to 2.5 cm a pixel
gsdBands.description: Typical scouting orthomosaic. Rows found, weeds of about 5 to 10 cm resolvable by the four-pixel rule, crop vs weed by position only.

gsdBands.name: 2.5 to 5 cm a pixel
gsdBands.description: High flights and downsampled maps. Rows of 76 cm still resolve; seedling plants are dots; cover by position only, single weeds under 10 to 20 cm are not objects.

gsdBands.name: over 5 cm a pixel
gsdBands.description: Patch-scale only. Row-crop rows marginal or lost; no plant-level claims.

smallestObjectRule.statement: At least four pixels across are needed to detect the smallest object of interest; an object narrower is not claimed, and its size is not measured.
smallestObjectRule.source: Peña, Torres-Sánchez, Serrano-Pérez, de Castro, López-Granados 2015, Sensors 15:5609, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4435221/

checks.name: Known pixel size
checks.definition: The ground size of a pixel comes from the map's georeference, the frame's EXIF/XMP altitude with camera geometry, or the operator. Without it no metric claim (spacing, size, area) is made: UNKNOWN_RESOLUTION.

checks.name: Pixel size against the analysis
checks.definition: Each capability states the coarsest pixel it is offered at (profile imagery requirements); coarser imagery disables it with INSUFFICIENT_RESOLUTION instead of producing a weaker answer silently.

checks.name: The vegetation split is a plant split
checks.definition: An automatic (Otsu) vegetation threshold that falls below the index of grey (excess green about zero) is splitting soil from residue, not plants from ground; the profile's index floor applies and VEGETATION_MASK_SUSPECT is raised.

checks.name: Shadow share
checks.definition: Share of pixels darker than the deep-shadow luma (50 on 0 to 255); cells above the limit are not assessed.

checks.name: Imaged share
checks.definition: Share of a cell inside the imagery; partly imaged cells are not assessed.
